Local._contextComment: Context window per model in tokens, e.g. [ { "Model": "phi-4-mini", "Tokens": 16384 } ]. Normally read from the model's own files in Foundry Local's model cache; set it to override that, or for servers that do not report it (such as Ollama).
Local._modelComment: When AutoSelectModel is true, the first PreferredModels entry Foundry Local has loaded (or cached) is used instead of ModelId. Load one with: foundry model run phi-4-mini
Local._comment: With AutoDiscover on, the app finds Foundry Local with `foundry server status` (Foundry Local 1.x+) or `foundry service status` (0.x), because the port changes on every start, and starts it if AutoStartService is on. Endpoint is used only when discovery finds nothing, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama (set AutoDiscover to false).

Summarization._comment: A document that fits the model's context window (after room for the prompt and the summary) is summarized in one call, up to SinglePassTokenCap tokens (~4 chars/token); longer documents are read in parts and summarized from per-part notes. When the window is unknown, MaxSinglePassTokens (sized for 4K-context models) is the limit instead.

Chat._comment: Each follow-up question is sent with only the most relevant document passages (up to MaxPassageTokens) plus the last MaxHistoryTurns exchanges. Documents smaller than MaxPassageTokens are sent whole.
